state_machine.raid: first completed bar trading beyond external liquidity by 0/1/3 bp
state_machine.anchor: opening price or body midpoint of the latest same-delivery candle among the raid bar and four preceding completed bars
state_machine.cisd_confirmation: opposite completed candle closes through the frozen anchor within three bars, optionally with raid-side or dual-side aggressive-flow confirmation
state_machine.entry_confirmation: first later anchor retest from the new side that closes back in the CISD direction
state_machine.entry: next exact bar's executable ask for long or bid for short
state_machine.stop: beyond the extended raid/retest extreme plus one bp
state_machine.exit: stop, target, completed anchor invalidation, or terminal NAV mark

economics.winner_removal: remove top 10 percent of positive 12bp event keys before complete rerouting

prohibitions: no risk rescue of negative expectancy
